tagline.en: Daily-pay eSIMs across 160+ destinations with carrier-grade plans
tagline.zh: 160+目的地按日计费eSIM，运营商级套餐

description.en: BCeSIM is the travel eSIM service of Billion Connect, offering plans for 160+ destinations from its official storefront. Most packages are daily plans billed per day — such as 1 GB/day or 10 Mbps/day unlimited — alongside fixed data bundles and true unlimited day passes on selected routes like Japan KDDI 4-day and South Korea SKT.
description.zh: BCeSIM 是亿点全球（Billion Connect）旗下的旅行eSIM服务，官方商店覆盖160+目的地。多数套餐为按日计费的日付方案——如1 GB/日或10 Mbps/日不限量——同时提供固定流量包，以及日本KDDI 4天、韩国SKT等线路的真不限量日包。

en: Daily plans: 1 GB/day, 2 GB/day or 10 Mbps unlimited per day
True unlimited day passes on routes like Japan KDDI and Korea SKT
Regional bundles: Europe 33, Southeast Asia 5, USA+Canada
zh: 日付套餐：1 GB/日、2 GB/日或10 Mbps不限量/日
日本KDDI、韩国SKT等线路提供真不限量日包
区域套餐：欧洲33国、东南亚5国、美加等
